sections.heading: What You'll Need
sections.body: Use exact birth date, time, and location. Use a free chart calculator such as mariesatori.com or astro.com. Keep a notebook for tracking insights.

sections.heading: Birth Time Accuracy Matters
sections.body: Even 4 minutes off can change your Rising sign. 2 hours off can shift house placements entirely. If unsure of time, request an official birth certificate from vital records.

sections.heading: If You Don't Have Birth Time
sections.body: Use a noon chart for planetary signs only. Avoid house-based interpretations. Focus on Sun, Moon, and planetary sign placements.
